status: proposed for the pre-load orientation freeze; not frozen
inputs_read: condition definitions in the executed FitLins models, producer event-edit code, task sidecars, dataset READMEs and titles; no map, header, PNG, group report or score

evidence_codes.S: documented in a sidecar, dataset README or the episode's methods record
evidence_codes.L: explicit condition label in the dataset as fitted (after producer edits)
evidence_codes.P: producer relabelling not documented by the dataset (assumed)
evidence_codes.I: interpretation of coded or ambiguous labels (assumed)

construction_codes.E: construction verified from the events actually used
construction_codes.X: construction set by a transformation in the executed model
construction_codes.O: original dataset column taken as the named quantity (assumed)
construction_codes.U: undocumented sign of a signed quantity

defaults.rt_reg.*: duration regressor when the executed model assigns response time to its duration
defaults.other: parametric (amplitude) regressor; direction must be given here or it stays unresolved

balloon.note: Schonberg et al. 2012: control balloons carry no reward or risk (October 5 record)

outcome.note: Schonberg et al. 2012: cashing out banks the balloon's money; an explosion loses it

cash_demean._quantity: pumps on the cashed balloon minus run mean

explode_demean._quantity: pumps on the exploded balloon minus run mean

feedback_uncertainty.note: probabilistic feedback carries more outcome uncertainty than deterministic feedback

distance from indifference._quantity: distance of the gamble from the participant's indifference point

trial.note: go trials are the control for stop trials

signal.note: noncritical stop signals do not require stopping and control for the critical ones

demeaned_pumps._quantity: pump ordinal within trial minus trial mean (producer code first committed 2025-08-07; columns present in the fitted designs)

demeaned_cashout._quantity: terminal pumps + 1 minus the cash-out mean (producer code)

demeaned_explode._quantity: terminal pumps + 1 minus the explosion mean (producer code)

instruction.note: attend (look) is the control for regulation

switch.note: first and second language tokens differ (switch) or match

content.note: false-photograph stories are the standard control for false-belief stories

response.note: trials without a response treated as the absence of the response process

stimulus.note: README trigger table: famous, unfamiliar and scrambled faces

exposure.note: README: initial, immediate repeat, delayed repeat; ordered by prior presentations

saccade.note: visually guided saccades are the control for antisaccades

block.note: assumed: later minus earlier performance block

moral.note: codes decoded against the dataset title: a_pha physical harm accidental ... j_ni neutral intentional

load.note: conditioned-stimulus labels encode an ordered nutrient load; only the order is used

trial.note: catch trials assumed to be the control for real trials

pm.note: face/scene prospective-memory trials versus the ongoing lexical-decision task

trial.note: catch trials assumed to be the control for real trials

familiarity.note: dataset title 'Personally familiar faces'; control identities assumed unfamiliar; oddball role unknown

conflict.note: name-face priming; incongruent primes mismatch the face

signedcolor_abs._quantity: absolute colour coherence (producer abs of the signed column)

signedcolor_cohright._quantity: colour coherence signed toward the rightward response (lateral pole declared by the column name)

signedmotion_cohright._quantity: motion coherence signed toward the rightward response

gain_demean._quantity: potential gain, Demean transformation in the executed model

loss_demean._quantity: potential loss magnitude, Demean transformation in the executed model

DELTAVALUE._quantity: signed value difference; which option is subtracted is undocumented

item.note: studied (old) items carry more prior exposure

liking_demean._quantity: liking rating, Scale(demean) in the executed model

target.note: no documented asymmetry between self and friend judgements; category convention

intensity.note: producer mapped T1->t_low, T2->t_hi, P1->p_hi, P2->p_low; not documented by the dataset

modality.note: producer contrast names read T as texture and P as vibration

opponent.note: computer opponent is the non-social control

sentence.note: 'ah' read as the speech-act condition from the producer contrast names

stimulus.note: sidecar: 1 printed word, 2 spoken word, 3 rest fixation

rest.note: sidecar: 1 rest, 3 semantic task, 4 control task, 5 irrelevant (modelled and discarded)

exposure.note: README: each list studied three times (T1-T3); producer mapped rep1-3 to word_list1-3

item.note: studied targets carry prior exposure; lures and foils do not

response.note: recognition response is a judgement, not an exposure count

instim_valcent._quantity: normative valence centred within cued-recall images
